title: Infix to postfix

milestone.title: From Machine Code to Modern Languages

description:
Turn ordinary arithmetic into stack-machine code with the shunting-yard algorithm.

```
2 + 3 * 4       ->  2 3 4 * +
(2 + 3) * 4     ->  2 3 + 4 *
10 - 4 - 3      ->  10 4 - 3 -
```
hints: Before pushing an operator, pop operators with greater or equal precedence to the output (lesson 5.03).
`(` is pushed; `)` pops to the output until the matching `(`, which is thrown away.
requirements: Use an output list and an operator stack.
`*` and `/` come before `+` and `-`; equal ones group from the left.
Then run the postfix with a small evaluator and print the result.
stretch: Use your tokenizer project so spaces are no longer needed.
